description: React component for rendering a right-hand side (RHS) card in Mattermost, including handling scroll events, rendering post content, user profile, and navigation.

classes.name: RhsCard
classes.description: React component class for displaying a RHS card with post details, user info, and navigation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the RhsCard component, sets up delayed scroll stop action, and initial state.

methods.name: shouldComponentUpdate
methods.description: Optimizes re-rendering by comparing selected post props and scroll state.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events, sets scrolling state, and triggers delayed scroll stop.

methods.name: handleScrollStop
methods.description: Resets scrolling state after scroll stops.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the jump link, closes RHS on mobile view.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the RHS card UI, including post content, user profile, and navigation links.
